name: Anime restyle
description: Restyle the video as hand-drawn anime with clean ink outlines, cel shading and painted backgrounds.

prompt.default: The source video remade from scratch as a hand-drawn 2D anime film. Every object, the architecture, the plants, the ground and the sky are redrawn with clean ink outlines, flat cel-shaded color and painted backgrounds. Not live action, not a photograph, not CGI. Only the layout, action and camera move of the source video stay the same.
prompt.local-wan: From the first frame, the entire scene is rebuilt as a hand-drawn 2D anime film. Clean ink contours enclose flat cel-shaded colors; architecture, foliage and sky become painted animation backgrounds. The layout and movement follow the source video, with this treatment sustained in every frame.
